scenario_description:
Objective: Avoid preventable public exposure of a capstone gallery draft while preserving the internal review path.
Emerging Need: Early showcase planning is unsettled and a privacy hold would be premature; a later assigned public queue ticket makes leaving the draft as-is risky before roster export.
Decision Context: Stored capstone records identify the affected learner-owned synthesis draft, its unanonymized peer-feedback content, and the limited privacy-hold route; live notices provide the verified desk, ticket, link, and cutoff.
Consequence: Timely handling can keep the current review package out of the public gallery; after export, the July launch will use the exposed draft despite no publication having occurred yet.

parameter.subject: Capstone showcase staging note for July review
parameter.body: The July capstone showcase plan is still pending the compliance sweep. Some entries may stay internal for reviewer feedback, while others may be mirrored to the public gallery. Gallery privacy holds will only be processed for assigned queue tickets after the sweep; early hold requests are not attached to reviewer sequencing.

parameter.title: Capstone portfolio review and possible gallery prep
parameter.description: Internal reviewer panel with possible public showcase staging pending queue notice.

parameter.name: Continuing Ed Portfolio Desk
parameter.notes: Verified desk for capstone gallery privacy holds after queue assignment; handles ticket-based roster changes before export.

parameter.content: Compliance sweep complete: your capstone package has been assigned public gallery queue ticket GQ-8821 with draft link cp-rowan-2026. Privacy holds for this queue must be filed through the Portfolio Desk by 2026-06-27 16:30 ET; roster export begins after that cutoff.

parameter.subject: Capstone gallery roster export complete
parameter.body: The July capstone public-gallery roster export completed at 16:30 ET. Queue ticket GQ-8821 is now in the launch roster using draft link cp-rowan-2026. Privacy holds filed after export apply only to future showcase cycles, not to the July launch package.
